MMS22L.reasoning: MMS22L-TONSL, homologous recombination at collapsed forks. Fork instability -> checkpoint.

NRDE2.reasoning: Binds MTREX and restrains nuclear exosome targeting. Loss deregulates exosome-mediated decay.

NRF1.reasoning: Nuclear respiratory factor 1: the master activator of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes. Its 53 measured activated targets should FALL when it is removed.

NUP54.reasoning: Central FG channel of the NPC. mRNA export and nucleocytoplasmic transport fail.

NUP88.reasoning: Cytoplasmic-face NUP with NUP214; export side of the pore.

OGFOD1.reasoning: Prolyl hydroxylase of RPS23 in the decoding centre. Loss degrades translation fidelity and triggers a stress response rather than a biogenesis collapse.

OGT.reasoning: O-GlcNAc transferase; also cleaves HCF1. Modifies Pol II CTD and thousands of nuclear proteins, so the effect is broad rather than pathway-specific.

PAM16.reasoning: Regulates the TIM23 import motor. Matrix protein import stalls -> mitochondrial stress -> ISR. The mtDNA-encoded OXPHOS genes that would also move are tide and unscoreable.

PCNA.reasoning: Sliding clamp for every replicative polymerase and most repair. Broadest replication lesion.

PHB2.reasoning: Prohibitin complex, inner-membrane scaffold and m-AAA protease partner.

PMPCB.reasoning: Mitochondrial processing peptidase beta: presequences are not cleaved, unprocessed precursors accumulate in the matrix -> the same ISR.

PNPT1.reasoning: PNPase: mitochondrial RNA degradation and RNA import. Loss gives mitochondrial dsRNA accumulation, which is sensed -- so an interferon arm is plausible on top of the ISR.

POLR1A.reasoning: RNA Pol I catalytic subunit -- no 47S pre-rRNA at all. The most upstream RiBi lesion here.

POP1.reasoning: RNase P / RNase MRP shared subunit: tRNA 5' processing AND rRNA processing both fail.

PRPF40A.reasoning: Bridges U1 to the branch point; 3'-end processing too.

RAD21.reasoning: Cohesin kleisin. Sister chromatid cohesion fails and, separately, cohesin shapes enhancer-promoter contacts, so transcription is broadly perturbed alongside the cell-cycle arm.

RBBP5.reasoning: Core of every SET1/MLL H3K4 methyltransferase complex, with WDR5/ASH2L/DPY30.

RUVBL1.reasoning: AAA+ ATPase of R2TP: assembles Pol II, snoRNPs, PIKKs and the TIP60/INO80 remodellers. Hits Pol II assembly and ribosome biogenesis at once.
